# Candidate historical county maize outcomes

`maize_2012_2020_mirror.xlsx` was retrieved from the third-party [GitHub mirror](https://github.com/Msang-dev/kenya-maize-forecast/blob/main/Maize-Production-2012-2020-Combined.xlsx), Git blob SHA-1 `1cf0cc869561ca33f33fa9acfb03365bb2e161f4`, SHA-256 `bf3a9c79d1c090cd73d82086e9b266967a4ad1c65377ebb0591697c366b02dfe`. The [KNBS National Information Platform catalogue](https://nipfn.knbs.or.ke/download/maize-production-by-county-2012-2020/) describes a same-named workbook, credits Kilimodata, and lists years 2012–2020. We could not directly download the primary workbook from this sandbox, so **we have not verified that the mirror matches the primary file or confirmed redistribution rights**. Verify these with the data owner before external publication or operational use.

The workbook includes 2012–2018 and 2020, not 2019. The `Sheet4` records report county, year, harvested area, production and yield in tonnes per hectare. These are reported historical maize yields, not real-time crop loss and not independently field-verified. Values are not adjusted.

`maize_outcomes_clean.csv` is the normalized, quality-flagged form of the workbook. The transformation is preserved in `data_pipeline/legacy_reference/prepare_maize_outcomes.py.txt`; the table itself is validated by the test suite. County aliases are normalized, source names retained, and basic quality flags added. Three records are excluded from maps and models, not silently fixed: Mandera 2012 has yield inconsistent with production/area; Wajir 2016 and Nairobi 2020 have zero harvested area. The workbook is preserved unchanged.
